answer: Make exit capacity the scarce thing, not earning. Locked rewards unlock through a river of release lanes, one lane per payout destination, each draining at a single seat's rate. Destinations linked by on-ledger flows within two hops merge into one lane. A farm of a hundred seats can earn a hundred shares, yet every pearl waits in one queue and stays slashable while locked, so if an audit exposes the ring, the whole ivory hoard is forfeit before much of it ever leaves.
